doc.title: Louis Armstrong and Herman Chittison Interview, 1960-05-04

title: Chittison and Armstrong in Europe in 1933 and patriotism abroad
summary: They sort out who went to Europe first (1933, with Willie Lewis). Armstrong describes the band in Paris, Americans picking up local habits, and playing the Star-Spangled Banner abroad.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
